## Experimental Design

The pipeline targets the **mouse microbead occlusion model** of glaucoma (C57BL/6J), which provides inducible IOP elevation with timed onset, wild-type background, and compatibility with Slide-tag. Contralateral eyes serve as within-animal controls.

| Design element | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| **Platform** | Slide-tag | True single-nucleus resolution; R2 cDNA enables RNA velocity |
| **Model** | C57BL/6J microbead occlusion | Inducible, timed, no confounding mutations |
| **Timepoints** | Baseline / Early (2–4 wk) / Mid (6–8 wk) / Late (12+ wk) | Captures initiation through established neurodegeneration |
| **Replicates** | 5 animals × 4 timepoints × 2 eyes | Powers scCODA (≥3) and Moran's I test (≥300 RGCs/group) |
| **Tissues** | Retina cross-section + ONH | RGC bodies + axon injury site |
| **Control** | Contralateral eye | Within-animal removes inter-animal IOP variability |

    <div class="test-id">Glial response</div>
    <div class="test-title">Müller Glia</div>
    <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0;">Terminal state: <code>Muller_reactive</code>. Gfap/Vim/Lcn2↑, Rlbp1/Glul↓. Key mediator of neuroprotection vs. toxicity switch.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="test-block" style="border-left-color:#9ba8bc;">
    <div class="test-id">Neuroinflammation</div>
    <div class="test-title">Microglia (DAM)</div>
    <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0;">Terminal state: <code>Microglia_DAM</code>. Trem2/Apoe/Lpl/Cst7↑, P2ry12/Cx3cr1↓. Spatially tracked near ONH.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="test-block" style="border-left-color:#f4617a;">
    <div class="test-id">ONH-specific</div>
    <div class="test-title">ONH Astrocytes</div>
    <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0;">Terminal state: <code>Astrocyte_reactive_ONH</code>. Gfap/Serpina3n/C3↑. Lamina cribrosa-adjacent remodeling.</p>
  </div>

</div>

## Reference Datasets

The pipeline uses public datasets at two points: as annotation references (cell type label transfer) and as biological benchmarks (expected gene signatures at known disease stages).

| Dataset | Access | Role |
|---|---|---|
| MRCA — Li et al. 2024 | [GSE243413](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE243413) / [SCP2560](https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell/study/SCP2560) | Primary label transfer reference (189k adult C57BL/6J cells) |
| Macosko et al. 2015 | [GSE63473](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE63473) | Founding annotation; baseline cell proportion priors |
| Tran/Sanes et al. 2019 | [GSE133382](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE133382) | RGC subtype atlas (46 types, ONC time series) |
| Benhar et al. 2023 | [GSE199317](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE199317) | Non-neuronal temporal atlas post-ONC |
| Keuthan et al. 2023 | [GSE241782](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE241782) | Microbead bulk RNA-seq benchmark (retina + UON + MON) |

::: {.callout-note}
**The novelty gap.** No public spatial transcriptomics dataset (Slide-tag, Slide-seq, or Visium) exists for any glaucoma model — mouse, rat, or primate. The Keuthan 2023 data is the closest proxy available: bulk RNA-seq of the same microbead model with regional dissection. Your pipeline should reproduce its bulk-level signals (Gfap/Osmr/Edn2 upregulation at early timepoints; ECM remodeling in ONH) as a cross-platform validation checkpoint before primary endpoint analysis.
:::
